brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Brief covers critical developments in digital trade diplomacy, deep-tech policy frameworks, judicial limits under Article 142, climate resilience in agriculture, and space technology applications.

articles.title: India and ASEAN Finalize Framework for Cross-Border Real-Time Digital Payments Integration
articles.summary: India and ASEAN member states signed a landmark agreement to interlink fast payment systems like UPI across Southeast Asia to lower transaction costs and enhance trade.
prelims: Facilitates seamless integration of India's UPI with regional systems like Singapore's PayNow and Thailand's PromptPay.
Aligns with the RBI's Payment Vision 2025 and India's 'Act East' economic diplomacy.
Aims to significantly reduce remittance costs, directly aiding cross-border MSME trade and tourism.
articles.mains: Examine how Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) serves as a potent instrument of soft power and economic integration in India's Act East Policy.

articles.title: Cabinet Approves Operational Norms for National Deep Tech Startup Policy (NDTSP)
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet has released implementation guidelines for the NDTSP to incentivize long-term patient capital, IP creation, and strategic technology commercialization.
prelims: Establishes a National Deep Tech Advisory Council under the guidance of the Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA).
Introduces specialized fiscal mechanisms like 'Patient Capital Funds' with extended gestation periods.
Focuses on dual-use critical technologies including quantum computing, advanced materials, and microelectronics.
articles.mains: Discuss the structural bottlenecks faced by deep-tech startups in India and analyze how the National Deep Tech Startup Policy addresses capital and regulatory challenges.

articles.title: Supreme Court Reaffirms Boundaries of Article 142: Plenary Powers Cannot Override Express Statutory Bars
articles.summary: A Constitution Bench held that while Article 142 provides broad powers to achieve 'complete justice', it cannot be used to bypass express statutory provisions or core legislative schemes.
prelims: Article 142 empowers the Supreme Court to pass decrees or orders necessary for doing complete justice in any cause or matter.
The court reiterated that plenary power under Article 142 is curative, not legislative or administrative in nature.
Clarified that Article 142 cannot be invoked to override fundamental rights or substantive statutory prohibitions.
articles.mains: Critically evaluate the balance between judicial activism and statutory limits in light of Supreme Court rulings on Article 142 of the Indian Constitution.

articles.title: UNCCD Global Drought Atlas Highlights High Vulnerability in South Asian Rainfed Belts
articles.summary: A new report by the UNCCD highlights compounding risks of climate-induced droughts on South Asia's dryland ecosystems and food supply chains.
prelims: UNCCD is the only legally binding international agreement linking environment and development to sustainable land management.
Focuses on achieving Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) by 2030 under SDG 15.
Highlights that over 50% of India's net sown area remains rainfed and disproportionately exposed to hydrological droughts.
articles.mains: Analyze the socioeconomic impacts of recurring agricultural droughts in India and suggest policy measures for scaling up climate-smart agriculture.

articles.title: ISRO and Ministry of Agriculture Launch High-Precision Crop & Soil Portal Driven by NISAR Data
articles.summary: ISRO rolled out a real-time agricultural monitoring system utilizing radar remote sensing data from the dual-frequency NISAR satellite mission.
prelims: NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) uses L-band and S-band radar frequencies for Earth observation.
Provides high-resolution spatial mapping of soil moisture, surface deformation, and canopy biomass regardless of cloud cover.
Enhances operational capabilities of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) through automated damage assessment.
articles.mains: How can space technology and remote sensing transform precision farming and crop insurance mechanisms in India?
